summary: Create a job template from Automation Execution > Templates > Create job template; Prompt on launch fields ask for values at launch and usually override template values; Job Type is Run or Check (dry run that skips tasks without check mode support); inventory requires permission; branch override appears only for projects that allow it.
questions: How do I create a job template in AAP?
What does Prompt on launch do?
What is the difference between Run and Check job types?
Why can't I select an inventory in my job template?
